resources.string: This backup is too large to restore (the limit is %1$d MB), so it was not uploaded.
%1$s (saved %2$s) goes to %3$s on this device. The file there now is kept as a safety copy first, and the next sync sends this version to the server.
This address uses plain http:// outside your own network: your password and your files travel unencrypted and anyone on the way can read them. Use https:// if your server offers it.
A login typed into the address is removed: use the user name and password fields.
Everyone who types the same name in their own app, with the same server folder, shares one wishlist (family, friends). Leave it empty to switch sharing off.
The name the others see next to the games you add. Empty = the name of this device.
Set a list name to share your wishlist

Wishes the others add appear in your wishlist with their name; when somebody finds a game, the shared entry says so. The list lives in the shared folder of your cloud folder, no extra account needed. Removing a wish removes it for everyone.
Shared wishlist is up to date
